name: swing-hats-only-2
about: Re-check: hats taken out of a kit by a merge, swung on a track of their own.

steps.say: make a house beat
swing just the hats, keep the kick and clap straight

name: fade-copy-bar
about: Re-check: a fade in one-bar steps from copies of single bars.

steps.say: make a 4 bar loop with drums, bass and chords
add an ending that fades out over 4 bars, one bar quieter each

name: wrong-key-lesson
about: A lesson where the user presses the wrong key, then asks.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
teach me how to mute the bass myself, light up the keys
did I do it right? the bass is still playing
make a 6 bar drum pattern on track 1 at 400 bpm

name: aux-track-drums
about: A request aimed at a track that cannot do it.

steps.say: put a drum beat on track 9
make a busy techno beat with a bass and a lead
it needs more space

name: seven-eight
about: A change of meter for a beat already written.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
now make it 7/8

name: send-to-device
about: Sending a project with no device connected.

steps.say: make a beat
send this to my op-xy

name: wobble-bass
about: Sound design from a genre word.

steps.say: make a dubstep wobble bass on track 3

name: two-chord-options
about: Options offered as takes from the lab.

steps.say: make a lofi beat with a bass
give me two different chord progressions to choose from on track 7

name: song-from-the-bridge
about: A long build over several turns, then playing from one part.

steps.say: make a verse: drums, bass and chords, 4 bars
now a chorus with a lead on top
add a bridge where the drums drop out
arrange it verse, chorus, verse, chorus, bridge, chorus
play it from the bridge

name: user-edits-then-double
about: The user's own hits, then an edit built on them.

steps.say: make a simple beat
I added some hits. now double the kick on the last beat
surprise me

name: what-key
about: A question about what was made.

steps.say: make a chill beat with chords and a bass
what key and scale is this in, and what are the chords?
make a hip hop beat
make it faster
make a short beat with a melody
how do I download what you made?
